item.title: Role Of Guest Reception Service
item.description: By Sri Sri Radha Gopinath Mandir 1) Who is a guest? The Sanskrit word atithi means ‘not scheduled’. An ‘unscheduled’ or unexpected guest is considered a representative of the Supreme Lord, since his arriving unannounced is just what the Lord might do to test His devotee and see how ready he is to serve Him in any situation. item.title: The Eternally Limitless and Me
item.description: By Abhijit Tolley At this point another question raises its hood, especially in the minds of the cynical. “So, after all,” they say, “all you want is your own happiness.
